comment_regular: Computes the actor movement vector from ActorAnimData +0x0C/+0x10/+0x14. For non-creature ground-movement groups, clamps the vector by TESAnimGroup root-motion magnitude scaled by +0xBC and, when the blend sequence at +0xAC is active, +0xC0; optionally transforms the result and can suppress Z.
